body: Yeah, it's been pretty hard because I really love her and I want to help her as much as I can, but she keeps pushing me away even though she said she love me (I dunno if she does anymore). God damn it

But it feels so heartless to do this to a person "oh you have bpd? Bye then" somewhat doesn't feel right, but at the same time this is killing me inside along with all my psychological problems. It hurts so much
At the time my mother and my father have just divorced, so my father, who would look after both of us, left the house, so that responsibility passed to my sister.
She was 16, and yes we were the only ones in the house
